name: aiya
description: Hand one purpose to a conductor of AI agents: it pins the purpose down through interview and research, settles the approach, builds independent pieces in parallel with independent fresh-eyes verification and automatic redo, and carries the job until the approved success criteria are met — you steer only at six checkpoints (/aiya:ty approve, /aiya:gm send back), pausing and resuming across conversations with /aiya:dn and /aiya:up via git-tracked run records.
